info.name: Get outbound Kakao Alim message logs

params.name: sender
params.description: The sender ID which can be alphanumeric or numeric.

params.name: destination
params.description: Message destination address.

params.name: bulkId
params.description: Unique ID assigned to the request if messaging multiple recipients or sending multiple messages via a single API request. May contain multiple comma-separated values. Maximum length 2048 characters.

params.name: messageId
params.description: Unique message ID for which a log is requested. May contain multiple comma-separated values. Maximum length 2048 characters.

params.name: sentSince
params.description: The logs will only include messages sent after this date. Use it alongside sentUntil to specify a time range for the logs, but only up to the maximum limit of 1000 logs per call. Has the following format: yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ.

params.name: sentUntil
params.description: The logs will only include messages sent before this date. Use it alongside sentSince to specify a time range for the logs, but only up to the maximum limit of 1000 logs per call. Has the following format: yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of messages to include in logs. If not set, the latest 50 records are returned. Maximum limit value is 1000 and you can only access logs for the last 48h.

params.name: entityId
params.description: Entity id used to send the message. For more details, see our [documentation](https://www.infobip.com/docs/cpaas-x/application-and-entity-management).

params.name: applicationId
params.description: Application id used to send the message. For more details, see our [documentation](https://www.infobip.com/docs/cpaas-x/application-and-entity-management).

params.name: campaignReferenceId
params.description: ID of a campaign that was sent in the message. May contain multiple comma-separated values.

params.name: useCursor
params.description: Flag used to enable cursor-based pagination. When set to true, the system will use the cursor to fetch the next set of logs.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Value which represents the current position in the data set. For the first request, this field shouldn't be defined. In subsequent requests, use the `nextCursor` value returned from the previous response to continue fetching data.
